notes.title: Types of Aviation in Modern Warships
notes.content:
[p]Greetings, Commanders![/p][p][/p][p]In Modern Warships, alongside the standard weapons found on most ships—missile batteries, grenade launchers, and torpedoes—you’ll also find a wide selection of aircraft. Most of them are based on aircraft carriers, a special class of warship, though there are some exceptions.[/p][p][/p][p]Aircraft are divided into several classes, each with a distinct role. Within these classes, differences in armament allow for unofficial “subclasses,” making it possible to use them in slightly different ways—for example, focusing on anti-submarine warfare or reconnaissance-strike missions.[/p][p] [/p][h2][b]I. Helicopters[/b][/h2][p]The only truly universal aircraft type, available to almost everyone, is the helicopter. This is the most common and accessible aviation class—unlocked as early as Tier I. Helicopters are usually stationed on the aft helipad of ships. Their main role is reconnaissance and the initial attack on targets that, for one reason or another, are outside the reach of carrier-based aircraft.[/p][p]When choosing a helicopter, it’s worth considering the weaknesses of your ship. For example, a variant with stronger anti-air or anti-submarine weapons can help offset your vulnerability to threats from the air or below the surface.[/p][p]There’s also a less obvious tactical trick: launching a helicopter in close combat. In such cases, enemy air defenses almost always waste their entire ammunition supply on the chopper—leaving you free to deliver a devastating missile strike while their systems are reloading and distracted.[/p][p]A versatile example here is the RAH-66 Comanche, capable of engaging a wide range of targets thanks to its arsenal: not just an autocannon and guided missiles, but also air-to-air missiles for enemy aircraft and torpedoes for submarines.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/3cdf13f88bff0f13e12ec96406df29175aca9f73.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]II. Fighters[/b][/h2][p]This class of aircraft has one key mission: achieve air superiority by eliminating enemy aircraft. That said, fighters can also be used for reconnaissance, allowing allied ships to safely engage targets you spot from a distance.[/p][p]Keep in mind that most fighters lack the weapons to effectively attack surface targets. At best, they can strafe with cannons, which usually isn’t very effective. Still, they shouldn’t be underestimated: shooting down enemy bombers or dangerous strike aircraft makes life much easier for your allies—defense becomes simpler, and offense safer.[/p][p]So even if you don’t want to control them manually, it’s still worth deploying fighters under AI control—your team will definitely benefit.[/p][p]There are exceptions, such as the MiG-35D Fulcrum-F, which carries free-fall bombs and can use them to strike enemy ships, temporarily shifting from its main role of clearing the skies.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/c24c717aa7a7cda5a1cfd8099c91e1ec9e9cc6c5.jpg"][/img][/p][h2][b]III. Strike Fighters[/b][/h2][p]The primary strike force of any carrier. Their tactics depend on their loadout, but in general there are two main approaches:[/p][list][*][p]High-altitude strike — delivering attacks from long range, staying outside enemy air defense range.[/p][/*][*][p]Close-range afterburner attack — a sudden dash to the target, unleashing the payload before air defenses can react.[/p][/*][/list][p]The second option is very risky—often the entire squadron is lost. But losses aren’t critical: strike aircraft are numerous in reserve, and new squadrons will eventually be ready to launch.[/p][p]A player favorite in this category is the Pan Spatial Strikeswitch, known for excellent speed and a well-proven weapons loadout, making it ideal for “hit-and-run” tactics.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/34248fc6065df3d9e761656361a1151ecb31e189.jpg"][/img][/p][h2][b]IV. Drones[/b][/h2][p]In real life, drones are used to provide air support without risking expensive aircraft or pilots. In Modern Warships, their role is very similar.[/p][p]Drones can be launched not only from carriers, but also from many amphibious ships and even some destroyers. Their main tasks are reconnaissance and delivering the first strikes against the enemy. Unlike helicopters, drones are faster and more durable, which means that with proper handling they don’t have to be “one-way missions”—they can return for repairs and rearming, then head back into battle.[/p][p]The first drone new players are most likely to encounter is the MQ-9 Reaper. Well-balanced for recon-strike missions, it should not be underestimated as a serious threat.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/031f8310c59216b92f9cb111d2846f3b811b1537.jpg"][/img][/p][h2][b]V. Bombers[/b][/h2][p]The ultimate weapon of assault carriers. These aircraft are the most durable of all aviation types and deal massive damage in a single run.[/p][p]Their unique feature is that they don’t launch from the carrier deck, but instead spawn from the edge of the map. This has both advantages and disadvantages. Skilled commanders often use the following tactic: an enemy who strays too far from their team is caught in a deadly trap—bombers inflict devastating damage, while drones and strike aircraft quickly finish off the isolated target.[/p][p]But bombers also have weaknesses: limited flare capacity and a relatively small reserve. That’s why they should be used carefully—choose targets wisely and don’t waste squadrons, because losing them early in the battle can deprive your team of its strongest weapon.[/p][p]A prime example is the B-21 Raider, carrying an arsenal of free-fall bombs that may seem outdated, but remain deadly—among them, a nuclear bomb. With a well-planned attack run, you can watch your enemy’s HP bar drop by half in one strike.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/38b5a121eedd8076951669da0f4222144f441e49.gif"][/img][/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Developer Diaries | July 2025
notes.content:
[p]Attention, Commanders![/p][p]Ready for battle on cutting-edge warships? In July 2025, Modern Warships has been reinforced with an arsenal of state-of-the-art military technology from around the globe! This update introduces unique combat units — from heavily armored missile cruisers to next-generation drones and strike fighters. Models are based on real-world prototypes, and their tactical capabilities are designed to redefine naval warfare. Fans of dynamic shooters will appreciate the level of detail, refined gameplay, and that signature adrenaline-fueled atmosphere of Modern Warships. Let’s dive in and see what’s coming with the game’s Steam release![/p][p]
[/p][h2][b]🛳️ Battleship USS Iowa (BB-61)[/b][/h2][p][i]Nation: USA[/i][/p][p][i]Tier: III[/i][/p][p][i]Role: Versatile artillery-focused battleship[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/2c347dec43af949af7e7dc0be8fee2cfedaaa9de.jpg"][/img]
USS Iowa (BB-61) is a prime example of a U.S. Navy battleship that has undergone extensive modernization. While retaining the sheer firepower of its main battery, it gained unexpected mobility for a ship of its class. Enhanced electronic warfare systems and new Bofors 40 L/60 MK 12-I (4×1) autocannons also make it a deadly threat to enemy aircraft.[/p][p]The main battery of this steel giant consists of three powerful triple-gun Mark 7-I (406 mm) turrets, boasting impressive projectile velocity and salvo accuracy. Complementing this, the ship is also equipped with six secondary Mark 12-I (127 mm) guns. Together, they are more than enough to strike fear into opponents at virtually any range.[/p][p]
[/p][h2][b]🛳️ Aircraft Carrier JS Hyuga[/b][/h2][p][i]Nation: Japan[/i][/p][p][i]Tier: III[/i][/p][p][i]Role: Aviation-missile breakthrough with unconventional tactics[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/283f51cb62d279d00e762c42ddca9e2c7bef0065.jpg"][/img]
JS Hyuga is a Japanese helicopter carrier — the lead ship of its class and Japan’s first aviation-capable warship since World War II. With a displacement of around 19,000 tons, it features a flight deck, hangar for multipurpose helicopters, and advanced command, communications, and air defense systems. Unlike traditional carriers, Hyuga does not deploy strike fighters but compensates with powerful armaments: missile batteries, torpedo launchers, RAH-66 Comanche helicopters, and the unique RAD-20X drone squadron, capable of deploying in wings of three.[/p][p]In gameplay terms, JS Hyuga offers a non-standard experience, blending high-speed breakthroughs with overwhelming assaults. Its strengths lie in high maneuverability, a large number of missiles and torpedoes, and an effective helicopter group. However, the lack of conventional aircraft and relatively weak air defenses demand careful tactics — either rapid strikes or providing long-range support to allies. Hyuga is perfect for players who enjoy aggressive, unconventional playstyles.[/p][p]
[/p][h2][b]🛳️ Frigate SPS SMART 4000 — “Silent Killer”[/b][/h2][p][i]Nation: Spain[/i][/p][p][i]Tier: III[/i][/p][p][i]Role: Stealth raider with technological superiority[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/61b7fdee6ba94b2cd7ef0e62639877495ebacf30.jpg"][/img]
SPS SMART 4000 is an innovative frigate with a hybrid diesel-electric propulsion system and exceptional stealth capabilities. It comes armed with the experimental OTO Melara Railgun, three missile batteries, and unique SMART Launcher anti-submarine grenade systems. Designed for ambushes, its hull configuration allows it to remain virtually invisible to radar until it fires its first shot.[/p][p]This frigate shines in skilled hands — requiring precise positioning and allied support due to its limited anti-air capabilities. Optimal tactics include silent repositioning, unleashing devastating strikes with all weapons, and quickly retreating under cover. The RAH-66 Comanche helicopter further enhances its reconnaissance and target elimination potential.[/p][p]
[/p][h2][b]🛳️ Cruiser ROKS Geobukseon II[/b][/h2][p][i]Nation: South Korea[/i][/p][p][i]Tier: III[/i][/p][p][i]Role: Heavily armored strike cruiser[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/40bd3deed42ebbfb8f2e9737cefa5f9546374e95.jpg"][/img]
ROKS Geobukseon II is a modern reinterpretation of the legendary "Turtle Ship," combining formidable durability with cutting-edge technology. Its armored hull and lateral thruster system make it resilient against enemy fire, while its unique Hyunmoo-2C ballistic missiles (which bypass missile decoy) and MPUH scout helicopter ensure superiority at medium and long ranges.[/p][p]This cruiser excels at methodical enemy suppression — delivering devastating missile strikes from cover while benefiting from powerful air defenses (L-SAM 2 and KSAM Block 2). It’s a solid choice for both beginners (thanks to its survivability) and veterans (who will appreciate its tactical flexibility).[/p][p]
[/p][h2][b]✈️ Strike Fighter MiG-1.44 Flatpack[/b][/h2][p][i]Nation: Russia[/i][/p][p][i]Tier: III[/i][/p][p][i]Role: Multirole strike fighter with stealth elements[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/0446d33b410d667f4f647599287d844147f3b6f4.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The MiG-1.44 Flatpack is a unique strike aircraft that combines stealth, speed, and versatile weaponry. Its low radar visibility and powerful GsH-30-3 (30 mm) autocannon make it deadly in anti ship combat, while Kh-55SM low-altitude missiles and X-MD-E M missiles (which bypass missile decoy) enable it to effectively strike enemy ships.[/p][p]
[/p][h2][b]🛩️ Drone Aksungur[/b][/h2][p][i]Nation: Turkey[/i][/p][p][i]Tier: III[/i][/p][p][i]Role: Multirole combat UAV for naval operations[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/5df39a5d7f51eb7dbbed8e26d7326daf9fa922bf.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Aksungur is a state-of-the-art Turkish drone designed for reconnaissance and for engaging both surface and underwater targets. Its main advantage is its diverse and powerful arsenal: long-range SOM-B1 missiles that skim the surface, medium-range CAKIR-SW cruise missiles that bypass missile decoy, and unique ASW Rocket ALS anti-submarine missiles. Its specialized design allows it to maintain high speed and agility while remaining easy to operate.[/p][p]In combat, Aksungur shows remarkable versatility, excelling against both single targets and groups. Its ability to engage submarines makes it an invaluable asset in modern naval battles. Combining stealth, precision weaponry, and excellent flight characteristics, this UAV can turn the tide of battle — especially when used in coordination with fleet forces.[/p][p]
[/p][h2][b]🚁 Helicopter FARA[/b][/h2][p][i]Nation: USA[/i][/p][p][i]Tier: III[/i][/p][p][i]Role: Next-generation reconnaissance and attack helicopter[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/92b5d3098ea142cecaab2d7ec5da201ad18d2b7c.jpg"][/img][/p][p]FARA is a revolutionary U.S. Army helicopter concept. Its coaxial rotor configuration and reinforced frame provide unmatched maneuverability and speed, while its advanced weapons systems make it a highly adaptable tool on the battlefield. It comes equipped with a unique Mk 25 (60 mm) grenade launcher capable of targeting underwater threats, and laser-guided missiles such as AGM-114M Hellfire II and Zuni APKWS (70 mm) for precision strikes on surface targets.[/p][p]Thanks to its speed and multifunctional armament, FARA is perfect for operations in scenarios with no air support. It can not only scout and relay data but also engage targets independently at various ranges. It’s especially effective against submarines and ship groups, using its grenade launcher and Zuni Mk 24 (70 mm) missiles to deal devastating area damage. This helicopter is a valuable asset for any fleet, delivering unmatched reconnaissance and strike potential.[/p][p]
[/p][h2][b]🚀 Missile Battery Naval Spike ER[/b][/h2][p][i]Nation: Israel[/i][/p][p][i]Tier: III[/i][/p][p][i]Role: Massed attacks to overwhelm enemy air defenses[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/6e1d4c30d4e331baf636b33a448204073d7a2763.jpg"][/img]
Naval Spike ER is the naval adaptation of the renowned Israeli Spike missile. While its flight speed is not its strongest feature, it compensates with lightning-fast target acquisition and extremely short launch preparation times. Its defining trait is the ability to bypass heat decoys, making it especially lethal during coordinated missile barrages.[/p][p]In combat, Naval Spike ER is best used in synchronized salvos to saturate enemy defenses. Its ideal use case is when hostile anti-air systems are already busy countering other threats. When launched in tandem with other weapon systems, these missiles become a nightmare for any surface ship.[/p][p]
[/p][h2][b]🚀 Hypersonic Missile HSTDV[/b][/h2][p][i]Nation: India[/i][/p][p][i]Tier: III[/i][/p][p][i]Role: Engaging aerial and surface targets[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/8d5a7c3d1f207c79415424cea1a4ffcc6581c9eb.jpg"][/img][/p][p]HSTDV is India’s latest hypersonic weapon technology. This missile combines exceptional structural integrity with a unique flight trajectory, making it highly effective against multiple target types. Its rapid reload capability supports sustained bombardment, while its extended range offers a major advantage in long-range engagements.[/p][p]The primary strength of the HSTDV is its versatility. It can efficiently neutralize enemy aircraft, surface vessels, and even concealed targets at extreme ranges. Its hypersonic speed ensures near-instant impact, while its powerful warhead delivers devastating damage. It is especially effective at eliminating distant enemy ships and clearing the skies of hostile aircraft.[/p][p]
[/p][h2][b]⚡ Railgun ERS Tensho (127 mm)[/b][/h2][p][i]Nation: Japan[/i][/p][p][i]Tier: III[/i][/p][p][i]Role: Devastating damage delivered at lightning speed[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/15ac97e4af02a1c5e1c7165d12f84a4839b49972.jpg"][/img][/p][p]ERS Tensho (127 mm) is a railgun with an exceptionally short reload time. It merges destructive firepower with instantaneous damage delivery thanks to its supersonic projectiles. Its area-of-effect damage makes it highly effective against clustered enemy formations and even allows it to intercept incoming missiles mid-flight.[/p][p]In battle, ERS Tensho proves to be a versatile support weapon. Its fast reload enables sustained fire, while its projectile velocity makes evasion nearly impossible. It’s particularly effective against stationary targets and dense enemy formations, where its splash damage truly shines. In the hands of an aggressive commander, this railgun is a devastating tool for fast-paced assaults.[/p][p]
[/p][h2][b]🚀 Torpedo Spearfish Mod1[/b][/h2][p][i]Nation: United Kingdom[/i][/p][p][i]Tier: III[/i][/p][p][i]Role: Engaging surface and underwater targets[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/484b72b50775fab55b98d48685c948b9f8f694a3.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Spearfish Mod1 is a deeply upgraded version of the legendary British torpedo, enhanced in every critical aspect. Its improved guidance system efficiently bypasses torpedo decoys, while its larger warhead delivers devastating area damage. Additional fuel tanks also grant it superior operational speed, making it one of the fastest torpedoes in its class.[/p][p]In combat, Spearfish Mod1 excels against all types of targets, from surface ships to submarines. Its enhanced performance makes it especially dangerous when used in combination with other torpedoes or anti-submarine weapons.[/p][p]
[/p][h2][b]🛡️ Laser Air Defense DragonFire[/b][/h2][p][i]Nation: United Kingdom[/i][/p][p][i]Tier: III[/i][/p][p][i]Role: Defense against all aerial threats[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/908bf0f2dc4ef70c0815de9a0ab0a7fa01849295.jpg"][/img][/p][p]This British laser weapon system is designed to counter airborne threats. It boasts exceptional accuracy thanks to its advanced mirror-based targeting technology.[/p][p]
[/p][h2][b]🛡️ Surface-to-Air Missile System KSAM Block 2[/b][/h2][p][i]Nation: South Korea[/i][/p][p][i]Tier: III[/i][/p][p][i]Role: Defense against aerial threats at medium and long ranges[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/cd80b15e7e7e195d1080ebcd4db70fe4a0824b35.jpg"][/img][/p][p]KSAM Block 2 is South Korea’s latest surface-to-air missile system, providing reliable protection from various air threats. It features extended engagement range and superior targeting accuracy, with an advanced guidance system capable of intercepting even high-speed targets.[/p][p][/p][p]And this is just a glimpse of what awaits you in Modern Warships on Steam! More units, updates, and surprises are on the way. Stay tuned so you won’t miss a thing![/p][p][/p][p]⚓ See you in battle, Commanders![/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Weapon types in Modern Warships
notes.content:
[p]Greetings, Commanders![/p][p][/p][p]Modern Warships is known for its incredible variety of weaponry and the ability to combine it in unique builds that reflect your boldest tactical visions. We’ll cover aviation in a separate article, but today we’ll dive into the wide range of equipment you can install on ships—and the strategies they enable.[/p][p]Currently, Modern Warships features over 1,000 different modules, including those locked to specific ships and aircraft. To avoid getting overwhelmed, we’ll walk through the main categories of ship-based equipment and showcase some standout examples.[/p][p][/p][p]There are six primary types of ship-mounted equipment in Modern Warships:[/p][list][*][p]Missile Battery[/p][/*][*][p]Cannon[/p][/*][*][p]Autocannon[/p][/*][*][p]Air Defense (AA)[/p][/*][*][p]Grenade Launcher[/p][/*][*][p]Torpedo Launcher[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][h2][b]I. Missile Battery[/b][/h2][p][i]Missiles are the backbone of any modern warship's offensive capability.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]They fall into two main categories:[/p][list][*][p]Fire-and-forget missiles: Once you lock onto a target and launch, the missile guides itself to its destination. A great example is the Chinese cruise missile DF-100. [/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/e227abf99206cac7d790df102c8c7ca7a73b4c05.jpg"][/img][i]DF-100[/i][/p][list][*][p]Laser-guided missiles: These track the direction of your aim right up to impact. They require greater precision and skill but let you strike exposed modules hiding behind terrain. Experienced commanders have even mastered "lobbing" these missiles over cover to damage ships lurking behind obstacles. The most beloved example? The X-51 Waverider.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/3185b66d2e29458f1df4f57e669dab0b9f918eb8.gif"][/img][/p][p][i]X-51 Waverider[/i][/p][p]
Some missiles can be launched from underwater, ideal for submarine captains. Others are designed to engage submerged targets, activating a torpedo stage on impact.[/p][p]AA missiles, like the RIM-174, can be used to target airborne threats—occupying a missile slot while giving you full control over your target. Invaluable against enemy carriers.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/3b3f878da32531a65355fa89ccb2a47e7486cb20.gif"][/img][/p][p][i]RIM-174[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Some missile batteries launch a single, high-durability missile capable of breaking through enemy air defenses and dealing massive damage. Others launch a salvo of smaller missiles designed to overload defenses and ensure at least some hit.[/p][p][/p][p]Missiles also vary in trajectory: some skim just above the water, while others arc high to strike enemies hiding behind terrain.[/p][p][/p][p]A few rare and powerful missiles are immune to countermeasures. One example is the Oreshnik, mounted on the Russian battleship Kronshtadt.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/85724dd87a355000b8017df287cfcea204f209c6.jpg"][/img][i]Oreshnik[/i][/p][p] [/p][p][/p][h2][b]II. Cannon[/b][/h2][p][i]Artillery installations are used across many ships but shine brightest on battleships and fast, elusive cruisers or destroyers equipped with multiple gun slots.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]In Modern Warships, artillery ships are as popular as missile-focused ones. Long-range gunnery requires real skill—factoring in target distance, shell travel time, and enemy movement. But a well-aimed hit deals guaranteed, uncounterable damage. Some legendary battleships can wipe out over 75% of an enemy’s health in a single full-gun salvo.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/afb055ef0a52ec7fd15938cb92e121054b407332.jpg"][/img][i]Yamato battleship cannons[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Cannons can't hit underwater targets, but some dual-purpose turrets can engage aircraft, offering additional AA coverage. The Chinese H/PJ-45B is a great example.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/e15ea1605d374737acc6c72cca08c788cea4ad9f.jpg"][/img][i]H/PJ-45B[/i][/p][p]
Usually, MW players pick cannons based on their play style. For stealthy snipers, weapons with high single-shot damage and long reload times are better, like the legendary German Monarc you can get in the store.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/c8ff1672eec3048e55ec3caf0d0e0f16e47e1dfe.jpg"][/img][i]Monarc (155 mm)[/i][/p][p]
Fans of close combat should take a look at rapid-fire cannons that fire frequently and deal significant damage to the enemy, but have a wide spread. [/p][p]
The game also features cutting-edge railguns with extreme shell velocity and high damage. The EMRG Konig is a top-tier railgun.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/384717a082ff0126a22423ed362275520c362e50.jpg"][/img][i]EMRG Konig (180mm)[/i][/p][p] [/p][p][/p][h2][b]III. Autocannon[/b][/h2][p]
This equipment type operates autonomously, requiring no input from the player. It includes missile-based, ballistic, and hybrid variants. A versatile example is the Seahawk Sigma (30mm).[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/607b044c35adbca3bd85490d14938beaba137268.jpg"][/img][i]Seahawk Sigma[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Autocannons automatically fire on all targets within range. Some models can even engage air and underwater threats.[/p][p]Install and forget—autocannons offer consistent damage and hands-free defense.[/p][p]

[/p][h2][b]IV. Air Defense (AA)[/b][/h2][p][i]An essential class for defending your ship against enemy missiles and aircraft. Like autocannons, AA systems operate automatically.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]There are four main AA types:[/p][list][*][p]Missile-based[/p][/*][*][p]Ballistic (gun-based)[/p][/*][*][p]Hybrid[/p][/*][*][p]Laser[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Missile-based AA, like SPYDER-MR, launch guided rockets at air targets. They deal strong damage but can be deceived by flares.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/c20cf470727bde2edc829dfa48929f115a9bfe0e.jpg"][/img][i]SPYDER-MR[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Ballistic AA, such as CIWS-II (30mm), rains down high-rate fire at close range. It's excellent up close but struggles against distant or agile aircraft.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/15b06f869a4e01c36d1c36e3200f60474a15e410.jpg"][/img][i]CIWS-II[/i][/p][p]
Hybrid AA, like the Garpun (30mm), combines missile and ballistic firepower, making it effective at multiple ranges.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/c83c38dc05a4504907b0e5fc526fd32dad8c4d1f.jpg"][/img][i]Garpun[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Laser AA, such as Japan’s HPLS 100, hits instantly, with no projectile delay or spread—and it looks spectacular in action.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/6acd4e2ca1f010c84d91f1b29d86a3a119f2f898.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/cfbe4711f8aaa0d14cb1bbe491a9d8871cf25987.png"][/img][i]HPLS 100[/i][/p][p]
The key to survival? Smart module selection before battle. A well-equipped ship is a ship that lives.[/p][p]

[/p][h2][b]V. Grenade Launcher[/b][/h2][p][i]A fan-favorite class that delivers devastating area damage at short and medium ranges.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Most grenade launchers require manual aiming and prediction of enemy movement. Some, like the Russian RPK-1 Vikhr, use guidance systems, behaving more like missiles—but can still be diverted by flares.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/f23f436daf2a8b20ea87b64846b574f3398e220b.jpg"][/img][i]RPK-1 Vikhr[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Many can engage underwater targets such as submarines and torpedoes. Others lack this ability but make up for it with superior accuracy and splash damage. A great example is the Turkish TRG-300 Tiger (300mm).[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/f7c8e5a82fbb0e32e8eb1be8d8ccd1f12bedffdb.jpg"][/img][i]TRG-300 Tiger[/i][/p][p][/p][p]A few unique modules also function as AA, like Israel’s C-AS—though these are rare exceptions.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/16b6313f3811eefb0f322d9e38ba178aa2799f3e.jpg"][/img][i]C-AS[/i] [/p][p][/p][p]When choosing a grenade launcher, pay attention to AOE (Area of Effect) damage. Not only can it hurt clustered enemies, it can also disrupt enemy missile targeting during launch—a powerful close-quarters advantage.[/p][p]

[/p][h2][b]VI. Torpedo Launcher[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Torpedoes are the calling card of submarines and their main opponents, frigates. They allow the former to inflict enormous damage without leaving the water, while the latter use torpedoes as their main weapon against submarines. [/p][p][/p][p]Torpedoes vary in performance but follow a common pattern: manual aim, launch, guided path, and massive impact. Their slower speed means enemies might dodge behind cover—though large ships like battleships or carriers often can’t escape. A perfect example of a heavy-hitter is the nuclear Mark-45 ASTOR. Two of these hitting home can cripple almost any ship.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/5a3e8a06df752b0a110ab4b09743b3f939efbd7f.jpg"][/img][i]Mark-45 ASTOR[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Unjammable torpedoes, like the Turkish Akya (533mm), are especially dangerous. Even submarines with countermeasures can’t stop them.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/50809a32cd2a15362bdad478f44fac9597dc549c.jpg"][/img][i]Akya[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Choosing the right equipment is an art form. Want to rain nuclear fire? Set up an ambush with laser AA? Dominate the seas from beneath the surface? In Modern Warships, your ship becomes what you make it—an elusive predator, a floating fortress, or something entirely unique.[/p][p]
[/p][p]Tell us in the comments: which equipment class is your favorite? And stay tuned for the next article, where we’ll cover the full power of aviation! 🛩️[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Developer Diaries | June 2025
notes.content:
[p]Modern Warships is getting ready for its launch on Steam — and that means development is more active than ever! Each month, we’re adding more ships and weapons, and June 2025 is no exception. In this post, we’ve gathered all the equipment that has already appeared or is about to appear in the game. Naval tech enthusiasts — there’s plenty to look forward to![/p][p][/p][h2]🛳️ [b]Ekranoplan RF Burevestnik (Project 905)[/b][/h2][p][b][i]Nation:[/i][/b][i] Russia
[b]Tier:[/b] III
[b]Role:[/b] Rapid flanking attacks[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/0f3151b699c0eba5d7fe5787efbb162608a7593f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The RF Burevestnik (Project 905) is a modification of a Soviet experimental ground effect vehicle based on the KM project. Its design enables very high speeds, though it significantly limits its turning capabilities. Reinforced hull materials have improved durability and expanded the onboard arsenal.[/p][p]Its armament includes three missile slots and RBU-2500/2 (212 mm) launchers capable of targeting torpedoes and submarines at long range. Defense is provided by the unique UKU-9K-502 BK (23 mm) rear-mounted system, highly effective against aerial threats.[/p][p]Project 905 excels in swift flanking strikes and skirmishes against slower enemies. True to its name — the Burevestnik (Stormbringer) brings the tempest for those bold enough to charge forward.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]🛳️ [b]Cruiser JS Ibuki (ASEV-1001)[/b][/h2][p][b][i]Nation:[/i][/b][i] Japan
[b]Tier:[/b] III
[b]Role:[/b] Multi-purpose support, anti-air, anti-surface, and anti-submarine[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/02cee99e519fb11131b170f51a2c576b4edba914.jpg"][/img][/p][p]JS Ibuki (ASEV-1001) is a cruiser of Japan’s Aegis System Equipped Vessels program. It features reinforced durability and excellent maneuverability. Its standard armament includes two missile slots, a main cannon, a helicopter, an autocannon, and air defense.[/p][p]The unique loadout begins with the modified RIM-174E (SM-6 Block I) missile, capable of bypassing heat decoys and hitting both surface and aerial targets. It is supported by the Tomahawk Block VA — a fast-launch, durable anti-ship missile — and Japan’s Type 12 SSM (H), which boasts high speed and a reinforced frame.[/p][p]Other key weapons include the American Mark-45 Mod 4B (127 mm) multipurpose gun for both air and surface targets, and the Type 12 Kai system that automatically destroys torpedoes at mid-range. Air defense is handled by the HPLS I-100 laser and the 23-Type A-SAM system.[/p][p]Modern and lethal, JS Ibuki is ready to prove itself in any naval operation![/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]🛳️ [b]Submarine RF Strazh[/b][/h2][p][b][i]Nation:[/i][/b][i] Russia
[b]Tier:[/b] III
[b]Role:[/b] Hybrid warfare, stealth strikes, and reconnaissance[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/88494ec2df9a9444b9b56a0e144003f18f2a22f1.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The RF Strazh is a hybrid warship combining features of a submarine and a surface patrol vessel. It’s built for mixed-combat missions and maritime reconnaissance.[/p][p]Its primary weapon is the P-800 Yashma missile — a long-range missile that can be launched underwater and guided remotely. Complementing it are the UPAM-122 Groza (122 mm) naval cannon with explosive shells and the A-22M (140 mm) rocket launcher — both used in surface mode.[/p][p]A special bay houses the Camcopter Strazh drone, used for target marking and missile launches. The loadout is completed with two customizable torpedo slots for underwater attacks.[/p][p]This unique mix of stealth, long-range damage, and flexibility makes the Strazh a dangerous opponent, even for larger surface vessels.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]✈️ [b]Strike Fighter A-10C Thunderbolt II[/b][/h2][p][b][i]Nation:[/i][/b][i] USA
[b]Tier:[/b] III
[b]Role:[/b] Air support, anti-ship and anti-armor strikes[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/9320ed4ca0c309ef62ca6dcf269a6776bdb6284e.jpg"][/img][/p][p]An upgraded version of the legendary U.S. Air Force strike fighter. The A-10C has received modern digital systems and an expanded arsenal. While its added weight reduces speed, its firepower more than makes up for it.[/p][p]It features the iconic GAU-8/A Avenger II autocannon, capable of shredding armored targets. Mid-range attacks are handled by AGM-65K A10 anti-ship missiles, while close-range strikes use LAU-10 X3 (70 mm) unguided rockets.[/p][p]Airstrikes also include GBU-39/B bombs with laser guidance and immunity to heat decoys, as well as GBU-38 JDAMs for rapid target acquisition.[/p][p]A true stormbringer, the A-10C lives up to its nickname — "Thunderbolt" — striking fear into any foe.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]✈️ [b]Bomber B-1N Lancer[/b][/h2][p][b][i]Nation:[/i][/b][i] USA
[b]Tier:[/b] III
[b]Role:[/b] Long-range strikes, fleet suppression, strategic dominance[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/50c4a941ebd3ac558ee0cdcf6db5e71c221f768a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The B-1N Lancer is a modified version of the iconic B-1B, adapted for naval missions. It’s equipped with upgraded radar systems, new engines, and additional hardpoints, significantly increasing its payload.[/p][p]What sets this version apart is its ability to carry nuclear-tipped missiles capable of devastating surface fleets. The B-1N serves as a tool of strategic pressure and unmatched force in maritime warfare.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]✈️ [b]Bomber Swordfish MPA Global 6000[/b][/h2][p][b][i]Nation:[/i][/b][i] Sweden
[b]Tier:[/b] III
[b]Role:[/b] Maritime patrol, anti-surface and anti-submarine operations[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/40c4eb7d62c7e20c90f6c5f9f2c15445b1d9eb97.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The Swordfish MPA Global 6000 is a Swedish multi-role maritime patrol aircraft designed for long-range missions and precision naval strikes. It’s perfect for open-sea operations requiring versatility and reliability.[/p][p]Its arsenal includes RBS 15 Mk. IV Gungnir long-range missiles that bypass heat decoys, NSM-AL missiles effective at mid-range with area damage, and the KEPD 350K-2 SF with a cluster warhead.[/p][p]It also features the HAAWC Mk 54 Mod2 (324 mm) — a high-altitude anti-submarine system that drops torpedoes from great heights and distances.[/p][p]Swordfish is more than reconnaissance — it’s a decisive strike against any maritime threat.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]🚁 Unmanned Helicopter Z-6B[/b][/h2][p][i][b]Country:[/b] China
[b]Tier:[/b] III
[b]Type:[/b] Reconnaissance / Artillery Support[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/50567cf9a7b20133d73aec1fa7ee8b830517d146.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The Z-6B is a Chinese unmanned helicopter designed to enhance naval artillery accuracy and carry out a wide range of reconnaissance missions. While unarmed, it boasts high durability and comes with a generous reserve, making it a reliable support asset in prolonged engagements.[/p][p]An essential choice for players who rely on map awareness and tactical advantage.[/p][p]
[/p][h2][b]L/52A1 Cannon (155 mm)[/b][/h2][p][b][i]Nation:[/i][/b][i] Germany
[b]Tier:[/b] III
[b]Type:[/b] Artillery[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/f2bc9f55b842526e3a39114e3ec232e5cb9a7141.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The L/52A1 is a German heavy-caliber cannon mounted in a fully automated turret with electric drive. It’s designed as a rapidly deployable system that can be installed on almost any platform.[/p][p]The gun deals area damage to surface targets at mid-range. Its versatility, power, and flexibility make it an excellent choice for fire support.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Nirbhay Missile[/b][/h2][p][b][i]Nation:[/i][/b][i] India
[b]Tier:[/b] III
[b]Type:[/b] Cruise missile[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/8dd82b17622d4059867236bcb090b148ed477745.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The Nirbhay is an Indian cruise missile built to strike surface targets. It launches on a high arc before switching to low-altitude sea-skimming flight, reducing interception risk.[/p][p]It features fast target acquisition, short reload time, and area damage — making it ideal for swift strikes and precision fleet suppression.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]ALKA (DEWS) Air Defense System[/b][/h2][p][b][i]Nation:[/i][/b][i] Turkey
[b]Tier:[/b] III
[b]Type:[/b] Air Defense[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/5114d689df4840a587ef593aa46eb88ef603f343.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The ALKA (DEWS) is a Turkish directed-energy air defense system that combines electromagnetic and laser pulses to intercept threats. Equipped with autonomous radar and optical sensors, it can independently detect and track targets.[/p][p]It effectively eliminates aerial threats at mid-range, providing solid protection against drones, missiles, and other airborne tech. A futuristic high-tech solution — already in your arsenal.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]TRG-300 Tiger (300 mm)[/b][/h2][p][b][i]Nation:[/i][/b][i] Turkey
[b]Tier:[/b] III
[b]Type:[/b] Grenade Launcher[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/03d9109a9b1a3f7b6e99def623aa6d62c98e14f6.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The TRG-300 Tiger is a Turkish MLRS system with four 300 mm launchers. It offers high projectile speed, excellent accuracy, and massive area damage.[/p][p]However, it has a long reload time and slow turret rotation. It’s effective exclusively against surface targets.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]T-122 Sakarya (122 mm)[/b][/h2][p][b][i]Nation:[/i][/b][i] Turkey
[b]Tier:[/b] III
[b]Type:[/b] Grenade Launcher[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/0eecb81a1463fce297999bd00b024601f44d1adc.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The T-122 Sakarya is a Turkish MLRS system with dual 122 mm launcher pods. It reloads quickly and deals significant area damage.[/p][p]Its key advantage is versatility: it can target both surface and underwater enemies, making it a great choice for flexible battlefield tactics.[/p][p][/p][p][b][i]And that’s just a taste of what awaits you when Modern Warships launches on Steam! More equipment, updates, and surprises are on the horizon. Stay tuned for news so you don’t miss a thing![/i][/b][/p][p][b]
[/b]⚓ See you in battle, Commanders![/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
notes.content:
[h1] Modern Warships on Steam [/h1]

[h3]🟦 What is Modern Warships?[/h3]

Modern Warships is a cross-platform arcade online action game where modern naval battles look like they do in reality.
Surveillance aircraft rush forward to detect the enemy from distance.
Cruisers launch volleys of guided missiles and try to reset enemy missile defences.
Submarines sneak up to surface vessels and jet fighters provide cover to the allied fleet from the air.

[h3]🟦 When will the game be released on Steam?[/h3]

We are pushing our best to have it in your hands by 2025

[h3]🟦 What platforms and control devices will it support?[/h3]

We aim to support PC & Steam Deck on Steam version as part of releasing our game on Steam. Players will of course be able to use their mobile phones and tablets with the mobile version of the game to enjoy cross-platform gameplay in Modern Warships.
Mobile phones & tablets, mouse & keyboard, and Steam Deck will be first-class citizens, but we can't possibly support [i]all[/i] the controllers in the world.
Users may try using gamepads and joysticks; support for most devices is planned for the game's release.

[h3]🟦 How much does it cost to play?[/h3]

Modern Warships is Free to Play!

[h3]🟦 What will Steam users benefit from Modern Warships on Steam?[/h3]

There will be Steam Achievements and Collectible Cards for skilled and resourceful commanders.
We also plan to release unique items at the launch of the Steam version.

[h3]🟦 Will battles be separated by device/platform?[/h3]

As with all truly cross-platform games, players of different devices will compete in the same battlefield, regardless of device.

[h3]🟦 Will I be able to transfer my progress from the mobile version to Steam?[/h3]

Absolutely. Being cross-platform means you can play anywhere, anytime, on your choice of device.

[h3]🟦 Does the game support 'modding'?[/h3]

We neither provide nor support any form of modding. Instead, we aim to deliver a fine-tuned, optimized, top-quality game build, playable on all our supported platforms.

[h3]🟦 How do I join the testing of new updates?[/h3]

We will make an official announcement when we start open beta testing.
Detailed instructions will be given there.
Stay tuned for official updates!


[h1] Core Game Play [/h1]

[h3]🟦 Is internet connection required?[/h3]

Yes, Modern Warships keeps a farm of servers that power the game experience of hundreds of millions(?) of users. Even for 'Offline modes', which we will describe later, we require internet connection.

[h3]🟦 Is it possible to play with friends?[/h3]

Of course, we plan to offer various functions to add (or sometimes block...) friends.
We even award squad plays through Daily Missions, and honestly the surest road (or shall we say, seaway) to victory is by squadding with friends!
We also plan to offer Custom Game modes, where you can play 'against' friends - both for fun and even for titles.
We will elabore more on this through a separate article.

[h3]🟦 Will there be clans in the game?[/h3]

There will not only be clans, but also
[list]
[*] Clan chats
[*] Clan leaderboards
[*] Clan tournaments
[*] Top clan awards
[/list]

[h3]🟦 What consumables are available for use in battle?[/h3]

We will provide the following consumables for ship captains to stay relevant in battle:
[list]
[*] Missile Countermeasures
[*] Repair kit
[*] Ammunition Reserve
[*] Aircraft Missile Decoy
[*] Torpedo Countermeasures
[*] Engine Boost
[*] Oxygen Reserve
[*] Smoke Screen
[*] Electronic Warfare
[*] Air Electronic Warfare
[/list]

[h3]🟦 What will the Battle HUD look like?[/h3]

The battle HUD will feature your ship/aircraft in a third person's view, with controls for
[list]
[*] Maneuver
[*] Armament firing
[*] Consumable usage
[*] PoV switching between ships and deployed aircrafts/vessels
[*] Radar (aka 'minimap')
[*] Unit info & stats (damage counters, oxygen, reload points, etc.)
[*] Alerts & messages (for detection, target lock-on, incoming threats, etc.)
[*] Battle info (timer, points, no. of kills, checkpoints, etc.)
[/list]
There are two very important aspects we aim to deliver:
[list]
[*] Battle HUD will be [b]optimized to the type of device[/b]. Mobile devices will have an HUD that makes optimal use of their compact screens, while PC users will benefit from a spacious yet user friendly layout which can maximize battle efficiency.
[*] Battle HUD can be [b]customized by device[/b]. Lefties? Check. One hand players? Check. Foldable phones and tables? Check!
[/list]
More details will be available in future articles, so stay tuned!

[h3]🟦 What languages is the game translated into?[/h3]

([i]deep breath[/i]) Here goes:
[list]
[*] Arabic
[*] Chinese (Simplified)
[*] Chinese (Traditional)
[*] Dutch
[*] English
[*] Filipino
[*] French
[*] German
[*] Greek
[*] Hindi
[*] Indonesian
[*] Italian
[*] Japanese
[*] Korean
[*] Malay
[*] Polish
[*] Portuguese
[*] Portuguese (Brazil)
[*] Russian
[*] Spanish
[*] Spanish (Castilian)
[*] Thai
[*] Turkish
[*] Vietnamese
[*] Ukranian
[/list]

[h3]🟦 What perks are there to help new users adopt to the game? [/h3]

We are making everything to make new users boost their fleet and inventories!
[list]
[*] Step-by-step tutorials
[*] Exclusive new user events
[*] Monthly Battle Passes
[*] Vault Passes for off-season passes
[*] Monthly major events
[*] Bi-monthly community events
[/list]
and many more!


[h1] Modern Warships' Items [/h1]

[h3]🟦 What are the types of ships in Modern Warships? [/h3]

Here's a list of what we've prepared [i]so far[/i].
We are also fully open to adding new ship classes if it may bring modern, realistic & interesting naval battles at your fingertips!
[list]
[*] Corvettes
[*] Frigates
[*] Destroyers
[*] Cruisers
[*] Battleships
[*] Aircraft Carriers
[*] Assault Aircraft Carriers
[*] Assault Landing Ships
[*] Submarines
[*] Ekranoplans
[*] Hovercrafts
[/list]

[h3]🟦 What are the types of ship-deployable units in Modern Warships? [/h3]

No navy goes to battle without air support.
Not only aircraft carriers, but also some ships, will be designed to equip:
[list]
[*] Helicopters
[*] Fighters
[*] Strike Fighters
[*] Drones
[*] Bombers
[*] Unmanned Vessels
[*] Unmanned Submarines
[*] Unmanned Hovercrafts
[/list]

[h3]🟦 What types of equipment can ships/aircrafts have?[/h3]

Plenty!
[list]
[*] [u]Cannons[/u]: artilleries, railguns, rapid fire small calibres, etc.
[*] [u]Missile Batteries[/u]: anti-ship/air/sub, laser-guided, heat-seeking, cluster munitions, sea skimming, ballistic, arc trajectory etc.
[*] [u]Grenade Launchers[/u]: unguided, laser guided, heat-seeking, and of course, anti-ship/air/sub
[*] [u]Torpedoes[/u]: light, heavy, supercavitation, nuclear warheads(!)
[*] [u]Air Defenses[/u]: CIWS, VLS, Laser, hybrid
[*] [u]Auto-cannons[/u]: anti-ship/air/sub, long-range, medium-range
[/list]

[h3]🟦 How would one go about upgrading these ships and items?[/h3]

The game will provide means to acquire & purchase "Upgrade points", with which the player can upgrade his ship and equipment.
Upgrade points will be made available from shops, Battle Passes, Events, and as other various awards.

[h3]🟦 What items will you provide for players to 'express' themselves?[/h3]

Apart from battle-related items, we also plan to offer 'costmetics':
[list]
[*] [u]Camouflages[/u], available to equip on any ship
[*] [u]Skins[/u], exclusively optimized for a single ship
[*] [u]Flags[/u] of countries, cultural/fictional symbols, and even memes!
[*] [u]Titles[/u], comprised of a few words to show (verify) the title owner's uniqueness
[*] [u]Avatars[/u], to put on the player profile page, and display it throughout all the game, including battle stats, leaderboards, chatrooms, etc.
[/list]


[h1] Modern Warships' Modes and Maps [/h1]

[h3]🟦 What game modes will be available?[/h3]

By battle mechanism, we will prepare five major game modes:
[list]
[*] [b]Team Deathmatch[/b]: Two teams fight against each other within a limited timeframe. Win by destroying your opponents.
[*] [b]Domination[/b]: Battle for control points. The victory goes to the team that either destroys enemies first or captures the points.
[*] [b]Deathmatch[/b]: All participants in the match fight each other. The winner is the one who destroys the largest number of opponents in the allotted time.
[*] [b]Escort[/b]: Two teams are fighting for the cargo. The goal of the escort team is to deliver the cargo to the port, the goal of the interception team is to destroy it. The team that completes its goal first - wins.
[*] [b]Tandem Wars[/b]: Battle of 4 teams of 2 players. The team that scores the maximum number of points in the allotted time wins.
[/list]
These modes will be available as
[list]
[*] [b]Offline[/b] games, with bots as allies and enemies
[*] [b]Online[/b] games, matched with individual or squadrons randomly, and
[*] [b]Custom[/b] games, designed for invitation-only, for all sorts of venues (fun modes, chill rooms, and even tournaments!)
[/list]
Some modes will be limited exclusively for:
[list]
[*] Time-limited, [b]Event[/b] modes
[*] Season-limited [b]Ranked[/b] modes
[/list]

[h3]🟦 Are there any restrictions to squad players? [/h3]

While we try to provide a battle environment where all players can compete fairly, we also do not want to restrict their freedom completely.

In general, players will be able to play in squads of [u]up to 5 people[/u] on any platform available at the time of release, and squad mates do not necessarily have to be in the same platform to play together.

There is of course an obvious restriction - squad plays are not available for [i]'offline'[/i] games :)

[h3]🟦 What maps will we be playing on? [/h3]

Scenes can take place in [b][u]any part of the world imaginable[/u][/b] - hot tropical archipelago, snowy expanses of the Arctic, pitch black storm amidst oil rigs, stone ridges with narrow escapes, post-nuclear ruins above toppled cities, etc.

In numbers, there will be [b][u]14 maps[/u](!)[/b] available for our main game mode, Team Death Match.
Other game modes will feature some of these maps to suit the battle mechanics and terrain requirements.

For example, Domination mode requires strategic points sufficiently spread out with debris, while Deathmatch and Escort modes needs carefully designed paths and safety zones to balance the tension.
Stay tuned for more news, as we plan to release a separate article that deep-dives into all the battle scenes of Modern Warships!

notes.title: Development Diaries | Ships & Equipment
notes.content:
Commanders, we continue sharing the development progress of the Steam version of Modern Warships. At this stage, we're excited to show you some of the new ships and equipment currently in preparation. All of these items will be available at launch — along with many more ships and modules!

[h2]🛳️ Helicopter Cruiser IT Vittorio Veneto (C550)[/h2]
[i]Nation: Italy
Tier: III
Role: ASW and helicopter support[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/f409afeadfcae29a6cb8d47332385d2092da2b9e.jpg[/img]
A legendary vessel and former flagship of the Italian Navy. Equipped with powerful missile systems, two helicopter slots, modern electronics, a unique 76mm gun with explosive shells, and advanced air defense — including a 40mm autocannon and an upgraded RIM-67 SAM system.

[h2]🛳️ Helicopter Cruiser FS Jeanne d’Arc[/h2]
[i]Nation: France
Tier: III
Role: Active maneuvers and strike raids[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/f35d7eb20a88c720b27bb61303fd73cd3567907e.jpg[/img]
A multi-purpose platform of the French Navy, combining the roles of a training ship and combat-ready unit. Features MM40 Block 3c anti-ship missiles, a CADAM Model 64 dual-purpose gun (100mm), and Sea-Ceptor JD air defense system. Agile, flexible, and capable of carrying up to three helicopters.

[h2]🛳️ Experimental Destroyer HMS Paladin (D200)[/h2]
[i]Nation: United Kingdom
Tier: III
Role: Tactical control and long-range damage[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/2ed5863a176beb239bef53f46764c7e2d0800a00.jpg[/img]
A modern British Navy destroyer with high survivability and customizable loadout. Armed with a unique electromagnetic railgun for long-range strikes and the Aster 30 Block 2 SAM system for anti-air defense. Includes multiple open slots for missiles, autocannon, grenade launcher, helicopter, and additional AA systems.

[h2]🛩️ Strike Fighter F-4S Phantom II[/h2]
[i]Nation: USA
Tier: III
Role: Heavy air-to-surface damage[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/f8746e7c371b4fa93d2a9ff87222775bd73096d8.jpg[/img]
An upgraded version of the F-4 with an extended arsenal: AGM-78 and AGM-45 missiles, a GBU-15 glide bomb, and AIM-9L air-to-air missiles — making it a versatile threat to both ships and aircraft.

[h2]🚁 Helicopter Wildcat HMA 2[/h2]
[i]Nation: United Kingdom
Tier: III
Role: Flexible airstrike and close-range AA[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/13b57f97ed9847302a59c4211b8b22523257be1f.jpg[/img]
A maneuverable assault helicopter with weapons for both ship and air targets, including the unique STARstreak air defense system for close-range threats.

[h2]🚀 IDAS Missile[/h2]
[i]Nation: Germany
Tier: III
Role: First anti-air missile for submarines[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/3185be210d09f227dfbef1d08ed0f1a2a0e8ac57.jpg[/img]
A one-of-a-kind mid-range missile launched from underwater. Allows submarines to strike both air and surface targets. While its warhead is modest, it boasts a very short launch preparation time.

[h2]✈️ Fighter Tornado F.Mk.3[/h2]
[i]Nation: United Kingdom
Tier: III
Role: High-speed interceptor and air superiority[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/5d0e014789354333843a35259cacd27bed8a1afe.jpg[/img]
An all-weather fighter with variable-sweep wings and excellent high-speed maneuverability. Armed with the DEFA 552 gun and Sky Flash missiles for precise multi-angle target interception.

[h2]Mark 55/12 Naval Gun (305mm)[/h2]
[i]Nation: USA
Tier: III
Role: Massive long-range damage[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/785e1c34d74504cabd5b902c2c8392d2850c0887.jpg[/img]
A prototype 305mm single-barrel naval gun from the U.S. Navy. Delivers devastating long-range shots against surface targets. Slow to reload and turn, but immensely powerful.

[h2]HyFly-2 Missile (Nuclear Warhead)[/h2]
[i]Nation: USA
Tier: III
Role: Precision-guided area damage[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/a7862e12671f7d57552dad6b01c6274ca71d028b.jpg[/img]
An American hypersonic cruise missile project with a nuclear payload and laser guidance. Designed to engage targets at extreme range.

[h2]RapidFire LMM Autocannon[/h2]
[i]Nation: France
Tier: III
Role: Hybrid air defense[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/b02d4dabf9d1aa56a8fcd1f841044f09f34cc014.jpg[/img]
A unique blend of LMM missiles and rapid-fire autocannon in a single RAPIDFire unit. Automatically selects optimal ammo types in real time to counter a wide range of airborne threats.

[i][b]And this is just a glimpse of what’s coming to Modern Warships on Steam. Stay tuned — more ships, features, and surprises are on the horizon![/b][/i]

⚓ See you at sea!

notes.title: Ship Classes in Modern Warships
notes.content:
In Modern Warships, there’s a ship class for every playstyle — whether you're a tactical commander, a fast-moving flank predator, an unstoppable artillery machine, or a lover of aerial combat. Let’s explore each ship class available in the game and what they feel like in real combat.

[h2]⚓ Corvette[/h2]
[i]Agile Entry-Level Fighter[/i]
 Small, fast, and armed with basic weaponry — corvettes are designed for newcomers taking their first steps in Modern Warships. They let you learn the ropes without overwhelming complexity.
💡[b]Tier:[/b] I-II
♟[b]Role[/b]: Training and light support
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/7613b5d16e1930c22a17801eadb428a8f20b9ec3.jpg[/img]
USS Hurricane (T1)

[h2]🔭 Frigate[/h2]
[i]Eyes and Ears of the Fleet[/i]
 With excellent speed and compact design, frigates are ideal for reconnaissance and quick hit-and-run attacks. Just don’t get caught in a prolonged fight — this class is built for tactical strikes.
💡[b]Tier:[/b] II-III
♟[b]Role[/b]:  Recon, flanking
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/7d45051162ebab7c70285a97b587df880ff68df3.jpg[/img]
RF Breeze (T2)

[h2]⚔ Destroyer[/h2]
[i]Balanced Powerhouse[/i]
 The most versatile class in the game. Destroyers suit both new players and veterans, thanks to their balanced stats, flexible tactics, and wide range of weapons.
💡[b]Tier:[/b] II-III
♟[b]Role[/b]:  All-round combat
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/eba5019d00ce10466f1634bf67a85e7540829efe.jpg[/img]
CN Type 055A (T3)

[h2]🛡 Cruiser[/h2]
[i]The Armored Wall[/i]
 Slow but tough. Cruisers boast powerful air defense, high durability, and enhanced vision range. Perfect for slow, deliberate advances and area control.
💡[b]Tier:[/b] III 
♟[b]Role[/b]:  Defense, artillery push
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/3e268e7e69f63f01b355324e70548bb6a5880e88.jpg[/img]
USS Long Beach (CGN-9) (T3)

[h2]💥 Battleship[/h2]
[i]Heavy Caliber Might[/i]
 Love dishing out massive damage? Battleships are your go-to. Equipped with huge guns and thick armor, they dominate in close-range engagements.
💡[b]Tier:[/b] III 
♟[b]Role[/b]:   Artillery assault
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/222a1255531605e2e84f52e21de5d28e8495a86f.jpg[/img]
JS Yamato Aegis (T3) in the legendary Midnight Vanquisher skin

[h2]✈ Aircraft Carrier[/h2]
[i]Air Commander[/i]
 Launch drones, fighters, helicopters, and strike aircraft — carriers bring an entire air force to the fight. Manual control over each unit adds strategic depth and variety.
💡[b]Tier:[/b] II-III
♟[b]Role[/b]:  Air support
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/5d1ebdfeb38b011985cb2dc57089f9d57260f81e.jpg[/img]
INS Vikrant (IAC-I) (T3)

[h2]☢ Assault Carrier[/h2]
[i]Carrier on Steroids[/i]
 More weapons, more aircraft, and a dedicated slot for bombers — and that’s just the beginning. Perfect for players who want to wreak havoc from the skies.
💡[b]Tier:[/b] III 
♟[b]Role[/b]:  Heavy air support
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/93e1f298139b92ed8aa709db106f57f964b3623f.jpg[/img]
FS PANG (T3)

[h2]🐋 Submarine[/h2]
[i]Master of Stealth and Survival[/i]
 Dive to disappear, surface to strike. Submarines are perfect for hunting high-value targets and turning the tide in late-game scenarios. A true carrier killer.
💡[b]Tier:[/b] II-III
♟[b]Role[/b]:  Stealth assault
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/9d6c25f4f19eba119a59e724ea0f5ca565b1b7cd.jpg[/img]
CN Type 100 (T3)

[h2]🚀 Ekranoplan[/h2]
[i]Speed Above All[/i]
 Skims over water at breakneck speed while unleashing a storm of missiles. Ideal for flanking attacks and overwhelming enemy AA defenses.
💡[b]Tier:[/b] II-III
♟[b]Role[/b]:  Breakthrough, distraction
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/5ec0fdfe36dcad835fcdf2512bb1bea5ab281046.jpg[/img]
RF Loon (T2)

[h2]🐙 Assault Landing Ship[/h2]
[i]The Ultimate Multi-Tool[/i]
 Carries drones, autonomous surface and underwater units — and sometimes even aircraft. Ideal for players who want to control multiple combat layers at once.
💡[b]Tier:[/b] III 
♟[b]Role[/b]:  Hybrid support
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/7eb31be04cace680ad175749a3fbe120bc687869.jpg[/img]
JS Katori (T3)

[h2]🌀 Hovercraft[/h2]
[i]The Silent Bite
[/i] Small, nimble, and deadly. Hovercraft are built for stealth missions and lightning-fast attacks in shallow waters.
💡[b]Tier:[/b] III 
♟[b]Role[/b]:  Rapid strike, mobile support
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/d7b160969fc544f4f4477a503f7df534f4b7583a.jpg[/img]
Pan Spatial Zeus (T3)


[h3]🚢 Choose your style. Prepare for battle.[/h3]
Each class in Modern Warships is more than just a ship — it’s a whole combat philosophy.
From stealthy submarine strikes to overwhelming air raids from assault carriers — you decide how to fight.

💬 [b]Which class is your favorite[/b]? Let us know in the comments — and don’t forget to add the game to your wishlist. The Steam release is coming soon!
